name: Flutter Kick
steps: Lie on your back with legs extended, hands beside your hips and your lower back gently against the floor.
Lift both heels a few inches off the floor while keeping your knees nearly straight and core braced tightly.
Kick one leg slightly upward while lowering the other toward the floor without letting your heels touch down.
Continue alternating kicks, then bend your knees and place your feet on the floor to finish.
tips: Raise your legs slightly higher if your lower back starts arching off the floor.
Initiate the kicks from your hips while keeping your abs tightly engaged and neck relaxed.
